title: Granola chat band
description: A loud lime band: a small serif eyebrow and a huge three-line serif headline on the left, and a big white chat box with soft 28px corners and a deep soft shadow that runs off the right edge on desktop. Inside, questions type themselves in turn with a blinking caret, a pale-blue chip swaps with each, and attach and settings icons sit at the foot.
notes: the band is the theme's highlight colour; text uses highlight-foreground
shows up to three prompts in a 12s CSS loop; with reduced motion only the first prompt and chip show
the chat box is layout chrome, not a media slot
